remarks:
This 3-bedroom, 2-bath manufactured home offers a comfortable single-level layout with plenty of room for everyday living located in the Village of Angelica NY, Allegany County.

This village home has room to spread out, and a backyard view that feels like you are in the country.

Step inside the home to a dining area and flexible office space. The kitchen offers abundant cabinetry, pantry-style storage, and an eat-in counter space. A convenient mudroom includes the washer and dryer.

The spacious living room is large enough for gatherings and features a large built-in entertainment center. The primary bedroom has its own full bath. Two additional bedrooms share a second full bath.

Outside, the 1.1-acre lot gives you room to enjoy the setting. The large backyard borders open farm pasture with views of grazing beef cattle, deer, and other wildlife. Take it all in from the pressure-treated back deck or relax on the covered front porch. The detached garage has a concrete floor and electric and is currently used as a small workshop.

The seller is motivated and ready to make a move.
